_doc: Config for the daily bracket-challenge routine. The scheduled job reads predictions.json + sources.json, scores via score.py, and delivers the board here.

delivery.format: ASCII board now; Panini image later (see image-prompt template)

data_home._doc: No external DB. The committed state files in this folder ARE the datastore ('fake DB'): each run reads the prior state, writes the new state, and the routine git-commits + pushes it so it survives to the next run.
data_home.persist: at end of run, stage these paths, commit, and push to origin/main
